_comment: Real, publicly accessible product pages from Headphone Zone (headphonezone.in), a real Indian audiophile retailer — verified in stock as of this writing. Prices are in INR. Re-check each page is still live and in stock before building the collector; product catalogs change. Keep the list under ~20 URLs while testing to conserve free-tier credits.

input_schema.url: string — the product page to scrape

output_fields.name: string — product title
output_fields.price: number — current price, numeric only (no currency symbol)
output_fields.currency: string — ISO currency code, e.g. USD
output_fields.in_stock: boolean — true if the page shows the item as purchasable
output_fields.url: string — the input URL, echoed back for joining

field_descriptions_for_scraper_create.name: The product's title as shown on the page, usually the main heading near the top of the product page.
field_descriptions_for_scraper_create.price: The current selling price shown to the buyer, as a plain number with no currency symbol or thousands separator. If there's a sale price and a struck-through original price, use the sale price.
field_descriptions_for_scraper_create.currency: The three-letter ISO currency code implied by the page's currency symbol or locale (e.g. $ -> USD, € -> EUR).
field_descriptions_for_scraper_create.in_stock: true if the page offers an 'Add to cart' / 'Buy now' action and does not show an out-of-stock or sold-out message, false otherwise.
field_descriptions_for_scraper_create.image_url: The src URL of the main product photo, not a thumbnail or a related-item image.
